evidenceFileIntegrity.method: sha256 before/after (working-tree self-consistency) plus canonical git-blob cross-check against the frozen manifest
evidenceFileIntegrity.workingTreeVsManifestNote: Working-tree SHA-256 differs from the manifest's recorded value due to this checkout's core.autocrlf=true CRLF normalization (no .gitattributes eol=lf override on these paths) -- the canonical git-blob SHA-256 (checkout-independent) matches the manifest exactly for all seven files. This is the same class of issue already diagnosed for source files during RESOLVER-V3-039's own v2->v3 execution-tree-hash remediation.

gateFindings.name: Representative quality
gateFindings.bindingRule: Top-1-Identifikation >= Variante A mindestens in DACH/COMPOSED/RESTAURANT, ohne Regression in SIMPLE/HOUSEHOLD (spec section 11)
gateFindings.defect: Aggregate-only comparison across every category combined (not the five named categories individually), and used strict '>' instead of the binding '>='.
gateFindings.correctedMetricNote: Historical per-case category+identification data was never persisted in the seven evidence files; only the already-blended aggregate rate survived. Cannot be retroactively recomputed without re-execution, which this task forbids.
gateFindings.codeFixDescription: computeCategoryQualityBreakdown in RepresentativeHybridV1LiveMetrics.ts implements the real per-category, per-partition >= comparison for DACH/COMPOSED/RESTAURANT/SIMPLE/HOUSEHOLD, using only each scenario's primary Variant C observation.
gateFindings.resolverV3_041Implication: Must treat the historical G2-A 'passed' as unverified/not certified, not as satisfying the binding rule. Future live executions will receive a faithful verdict once a categoryByScenarioId map is supplied (now wired by default in the harness).

gateFindings.name: User friction
gateFindings.bindingRule: Rueckfragenrate nicht drastisch ueber dem bestehenden Speck-Praezedenzfall-Volumen -- qualitativ zu pruefen, kein Fixwert (spec section 11) -- explicitly qualitative, no deterministic threshold
gateFindings.defect: Verdict resolved to 'passed' purely from friction.denominator >= 30, with zero correctness/rate check of any kind.
gateFindings.codeFixDescription: gateVerdicts.g2c_userFriction now resolves to 'requires_human_judgment' whenever friction.denominator > 0, and 'not_evaluable' only when there is no data -- it can never resolve to 'passed'/'failed'.
gateFindings.resolverV3_041Implication: The historical 'passed' must be discarded as a manufactured verdict. RESOLVER-V3-041 must perform its own qualitative judgment of the correctedMetric table above, in particular the low abstention-correctness rates (~4.65% development, ~5.88% holdout).

gateFindings.name: Consistency
gateFindings.bindingRule: Wiederholungs-Uebereinstimmungsrate nicht wesentlich schlechter als As (die strukturell nahe 100% liegt) (spec section 11) -- qualitative, no fixed multiplier
gateFindings.defect: Verdict resolved to 'passed' purely from overlayGroupCount >= 1, never consulting the already-computed real agreement rates.
gateFindings.codeFixDescription: computeConsistencyMetrics now returns variantAStructuralBaselineRate and variantC*AgreementDeltaFromBaseline; gateVerdicts.g2g_consistency resolves to 'requires_human_judgment' when overlayGroupCount >= 1, 'not_evaluable' only when there are no overlay observations.
gateFindings.resolverV3_041Implication: The historical 'passed' must be discarded. A real -31.25 percentage-point gap between Variant C's repeat agreement and Variant A's structural ~100% baseline should be weighed directly by RESOLVER-V3-041, alongside G2-B (failed) and G2-D (failed).

gateFindings.name: Cost
gateFindings.bindingRule: Development and Holdout must each be evaluated against their own telemetry, never a blended/combined figure
gateFindings.defect: Both partitions' cost metrics were computed over the full combined Development+Holdout Variant C telemetry (127 records) instead of each partition's own share (97 development / 30 holdout) -- development.cost.n and holdout.cost.n were byte-identical (127) in the final combined report, as was meanCostUsd (0.003719233870967744 for both).
gateFindings.codeReference: RepresentativeHybridV1LiveReportBuilder.ts (pre-fix buildRepresentativeHybridV1LiveReport passing the same combined rawTelemetry to both buildPartitionReport calls)
gateFindings.codeFixDescription: buildRepresentativeHybridV1LiveReport now derives a scenarioId->partition map from the real case records and filters rawTelemetry through it before building each partition's report, so cost is always computed over that partition's own telemetry only.
gateFindings.resolverV3_041Implication: Final verdict is unchanged (not_evaluable, correctly, since both partitions still have unknown-cost records) but RESOLVER-V3-041 must not cite the old blended n=127/meanCostUsd=0.003719233870967744 figures for either partition -- cite the corrected per-partition table above.

technicalFailureFinding.defect: computeQualityMetrics's armMetrics call for Variant C used the predicate '() => false', hard-coding technical failures to always 0 regardless of actual outcome, unlike Variant B which correctly used its own evaluation.technicalFailure boolean.
technicalFailureFinding.correctedPredicateJustification: VariantCMealResult.outcome === 'error' is classified by RepresentativeHybridV1LiveTelemetryProviders.ts as providerStatus 'network_error' if and only if the outcome is 'error' -- confirmed by direct code inspection, not inferred.
technicalFailureFinding.numeratorsUnaffectedJustification: evaluateIdentificationC never returns 'correct'/'acceptable_equivalent' for a case with no resolved component (outcome='error'), and evaluateExpectedBehaviorC has no branch returning {result:'match'} for outcome='error' under any expectedBehavior value -- verified by direct code inspection.
technicalFailureFinding.resolverV3_041Implication: Cite the corrected identificationMatchRate/expectedBehaviorMatchRate values above, not the original stored (denominator-inflated) values.

priorRehearsalReportDefect.explanation: The prior rehearsal report mislabeled real VAGUE-DEV-004/005/006 failures as UNRELIABLE-DEV-004/005/006, and never listed VAGUE-DEV-003 at all.
